response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js and DLang expertise, but the resume shows no evidence of Kotlin experience, Spring ecosystem work, or recent deep JVM/Java engineering — the core requirements for this role. While there is some tangential IDE tooling experience (C/C++ work on National Instruments' LabWindows/CVI IDE), it is unrelated to enterprise Java/Kotlin tooling and over a decade old.
strengths: Extensive, diverse senior-level engineering experience across many stacks and company sizes
Direct prior experience building components for a C-based IDE (LabWindows/CVI), showing some familiarity with IDE internals
Strong communication/teaching skills (workshops, talks, open-source project leadership)
concerns: No mention of Kotlin anywhere in skills or experience — a core required qualification
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or other enterprise Java framework experience
Java appears only briefly and long ago (robotics/device orchestration), with no recent or deep JVM-focused work
